verdict.rationale: Composio is a hosted SaaS that stores user credentials, so data region or residency choice is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack never mentions selecting a storage region, residency options, or self-hosting. Docs only say Composio stores and refreshes credentials against a userID, with no location control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
